children: Vitalik said he recently updated the EIP-8141 "Frame Transaction" proposal. According to Odaily, the proposal includes atomic batch execution of up to 64 operations, social recovery support, P256 quantum-resistant signatures, and the ability for anyone to pay gas fees for users.
The proposal was co-authored by Vitalik, lightclient, and eight other experts, and is planned for inclusion in the 2027 Hegotá upgrade.

title: Vitalik Updates EIP-8141 Proposal With Batch Execution, Social Recovery, and P256 Signatures
